text:
Cody (Finance): FYI INV-2026-0788 for Aurora Data ($29,760) went past due after the wire bounced today (bank returned: account_closed).
Aurora Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-0788 marked Past Due (due 2026-06-10). Reminder emailed to ap@auroradata.com.
Rae (AM): chatted with Marta earlier. They say AP closed a bank account unexpectedly during a vendor consolidation. asking if we can accept a split: 40% today via card, remainder in 4 weekly ACHs.
Marta (Aurora Finance): correct. we can do 40% now on card and schedule 4 ACH payments. we also dispute line item 5 (overage events) - our tally shows 9,800 vs your 10,200. need a small credit before finalizing plan.
Jonah (Collections Lead): policy is 50% upfront for restructured plans, but for enterprise customers we can go to 40% if they provide a PO and a signed email acceptance. we will waive one late fee as a courtesy.
Iris (Legal): email acceptance is fine for <$50k. please include this exact sentence in the confirmation: "This payment schedule applies only to INV-2026-0788 and does not waive Redwood Inference's right to collect any future unpaid invoices."
Evan (Support): quick note on the usage mismatch: engineering found 60 duplicate events from a retry loop in their pipeline. provisional credit equals 400 events (~$32). attaching reconcile csv.
Cody (Finance): apply the $32 credit before calculating the split. new balance = 29,728. 40% upfront = $11,891.20. round to $11,891.20.
Marta (Aurora Finance): OK we can do $11,891.20 now by card; will add AP contact and PO in reply. please send payment link and the exact email text we should respond to.
WireBot: Card payment link created for $11,891.20 - https://payments.redwood.ai/pay/INV-2026-0788
Rae (AM): drafting confirmation snippet: ```Hi AP team - we accept your plan: 40% upfront ($11,891.20) via card and four weekly ACH payments for the remaining balance after the $32 usage credit. Please reply with: (1) PO number, (2) AP contact email, and (3) ACH reference when each payment posts. Upon receipt of the first payment we will suspend dunning and waive one late fee. Reply with "I accept" to confirm.```
Marta (Aurora Finance): replying: "I accept. PO AUR-4533. AP contact ap@auroradata.com. Card payment initiated."
Aurora Billing Bot: Card authorization received; settlement pending bank clearing (2-5 business days).
Jonah (Collections Lead): hold escalation. if authorization doesn't settle by 1792080000 reopen dunning and escalate to Legal + AM. once settled mark as PAYMENT_PLAN_ACTIVE and tag WAIVED_ONE_LATE_FEE.
Iris (Legal): adding the exact sentence to the thread - use verbatim in outgoing email.
Evan (Support): posted reconcile CSV and credit calc; the final adjusted schedule included in thread.
Cody (Finance): I'll update the billing system to ADJUSTED_BALANCE and set a follow-up. closing for now but will reopen on exception. :white_check_mark:
